censoring.direction: left-censored (very stable end; more negative than measurable floor)
censoring.basis: Kd <= 5000 nM measurable range; cap is the most stable measurable value
censoring.likelihood: censored likelihood for rows at cap; do not treat as exact point values

construct_holdout.note: hold out whole junction_ids; leakage via shared scaffold/motif must be blocked

motif_family_holdout.note: hold out whole motif families; construct->scaffold reuse must be blocked

scaffold_holdout.note: only 9 scaffolds; high risk of scaffold-level confounding

study_holdout.note: single study (Denny 2018); cross-study generalization requires qMaPseq or other platform

provenance.row_level_checksum: per-row SHA-256 of serialized canonical JSON computed at build

license.note: NIH open-access author manuscript (PMC6053692); Cell article data. Verify the specific Cell license (Elsevier) before any redistribution; analysis/reproduction use is standard but redistribution terms must be confirmed.

decision_required: finalizer must confirm all T0 items before PASS
